name: aXtn Reviews
description: Searchable operational review surface over native AgentSwarms approvals, including technical intake registration approvals.
permissions: authenticated user subject to native approval RLS
native_capabilities_consumed: shared native approval decision and swarm-resume path (useApprovalDecision)
data_contracts: semantic classification approvals carry payload.proposal / payload.context and are rendered as a review context

intake registration approvals (action_title 'Review Intake Registration') carry the intake acknowledgement as a JSON string in payload.last_output, falling back to description; fields consumed: accepted, document_id, processing_status, processing_route, registry_outcome, next_location
source kind and provider file id are read back out of the namespaced document_id (<source_type>:<source_ref>) and never invented
a review is actionable only while status = pending; decided reviews are read-only history
known_limitations: Human Overrides are limited to allowlisted proposal metadata and remain subject to native approval RLS.
A registration approval has no semantic proposal to override; only its technical facts are shown.
Mixed string and string-array topic contracts are intentionally not bulk editable.
